sources.entry: Novu - Notification infrastructure for developers. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Novu is an open-source communication infrastructure platform that sends notifications across in-app inbox, email, SMS, push and chat through one API, and routes conversations between user-built agents and messaging channels.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes two halves sharing one API and conversation model. For products, Novu sends notifications across Inbox/In-App, Push, Email, SMS and Chat, with workflows that support branching and per-channel conditions, a digest engine that batches notifications, a no-code email editor, and an embeddable real-time inbox component plus a preferences component so users can manage their own notifications. For agents, it markets "Agent Communication Infrastructure," which receives inbound messages from channels such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and email, normalizes them, routes them to the developer's agent, and sends replies back. The README lists provider counts by channel: about 20 email, 37 SMS, 8 push, 13 chat, and 1 in-app provider. It also states that the repository follows an open-core model, with an `enterprise` folder under a commercial license and the rest under MIT.
use_cases: send multi-channel notifications from an application
embed a notification center in a web app
let users manage their notification preferences
connect an AI agent to Slack, Teams, Telegram or WhatsApp
route one API to many email, SMS or push providers
notable: Single API covering email, SMS, push, chat and in-app channels with many provider integrations
Workflow engine with branching, conditions and digest batching
Embeddable notification inbox and user preferences components
Agent Communication Infrastructure that normalizes inbound messages from chat channels into one conversation model
Open-core split: MIT core with a separate commercial enterprise folder
caveats: Parts of the repository under the /enterprise folder require a commercial license
README says React Native, Vue and Angular embeddable components are coming soon, so only React is currently offered
The quick-start npx command relies on the hosted dashboard and a free account, per the README
summary.license: MIT (core); commercial license for the enterprise folder
keywords: send email and sms from my app
